scope: Integral bilinear elimination, exhaustive finite monogenic four-column inverse tests, complete actual fans and the exceptional plane-plus-axis contractions. These support the uniform all-field proof, not an unrestricted G3 theorem, a power-separating family or novelty.

uniform_results.two_pair_defects: rank(1,x,y,xy)<=3 and rank(1,x,z,xz)<=3 imply g=O(n^2), over all fields and arbitrary finite quotients.
uniform_results.dichotomy: Either all three pair defects hold, a coordinate is scalar, or a coordinatewise affine shift puts xy,xz in I.
uniform_results.common_factor_case: For I containing xy,xz, only two x-axis lengths occur and one fixed-core planar matroid per length gives g=O(n*log(n+1)).
uniform_results.cyclic_inverse: With cyclic x and n>=3, the low-rank coordinates are constants, unit-denominator Mobius functions, or scalars plus rank-one annihilator elements.
uniform_results.sharpness: The earlier three-pole family attains binom(n+1,2), over every field, including repeated divisors.
